item.title: Version 2.5
item.description:
iPod Drop 2.5

  • Marked for Removal. Rate a song 1 star on your iPod and it appears right away in a "Marked for Removal" playlist on the iPod, so you can listen again and change your mind. When you connect, iPod Drop lists the marked songs with Review and Remove; nothing is deleted until you confirm.
  • Prefer it hands-off? Turn on "Remove marked songs automatically" in Settings.
  • Songs on your Mac are never touched.
